In that book he argues that strong artificial intelligence isn't achievable on classical computers, since the human brain seems to have the ability to do quantum computing in certain molecular structures. These processes probably can't be simulated efectively. So AI in today's computers probably won't work at all (although quantum computers or artificial neural networks might).

c.st: How to Build a BVH (Bounding Volume Hierarchy) on the CPU
c.x:
